resources.string: Drag and drop pieces anywhere on the board.
Refresh Tray
Tray refreshed
Drag anywhere on the board → release to place
Drag one of the three pieces onto any empty space.
Tray refreshed! New shapes are ready.
Rows
Complete full rows to clear them from the board.
Row + Column
A single placement can clear at least one row and one column at the same time.
Clear %1$d rows
Make %1$d row + column clears
Drag any of the three pieces onto the board
Three shapes wait in the tray. Pick the one you want, drag it onto any empty cells, and release to place it exactly where it fits.
Think about the whole tray, not just one move
After placing one piece, the remaining tray stays on screen. When all three are used, a fresh trio appears. Try to leave enough space for every shape you still have.
Rows and columns clear with full coverage
There are no special pieces here. Instead, fill an entire row or an entire column to clear it. If both complete together, they clear at the same time.
You are ready for the new block puzzle flow
Keep scanning the tray, set up row and column clears, and avoid trapping large shapes. When none of the three pieces fit anymore, the run ends.
Open Tutorial whenever you want to revisit free placement and simultaneous row/column clears.
Open Tutorial whenever you want to revisit free placement and simultaneous row/column clears.
Drag a tray piece onto the board
Touch one of the three shapes in the tray, move it over the board, and line it up with the highlighted cells.
Drag the highlighted tray piece into the glowing target area.
Nice — release now. Once it snaps into the highlighted cells, the next guide will open automatically.
Drop the piece inside the highlighted cells to continue.
Perfect — keep it there and release to continue.
Placement accepted. Preparing the next guided moment…
Complete a row to clear it
Place this shape into the guided spot so the row becomes full, flashes, and disappears.
Complete a column to clear it
Now use the highlighted placement to finish a full column and open vertical space.
Rows open horizontal space
A full row clears instantly. Aim for the highlighted cells and watch the board open across the width.
The tray matters as much as the board
Before you place a shape, glance at the other two pieces. Good runs come from leaving room for the whole tray, not just the current move.
Clear both directions together
Some placements finish a row and a column at the same time. Use the guided spot to trigger a bigger double clear.
